Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and has a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are five lines displayed. The orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at approximately 99.2 at 9e8 TFLOPs, showing a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations. The blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, starts at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at approximately 99.1 at 9e8 TFLOPs, also showing a generally increasing trend. The green line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, begins at approximately 97.8 at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at approximately 99.6 at 9e8 TFLOPs, with a similar increasing trend. The red line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, starts at approximately 94.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at approximately 98.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs, showing a generally increasing trend. Finally, the purple line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at approximately 99.1 at 9e8 TFLOPs, with a similar increasing trend. All lines are solid and do not contain markers.
